text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Two powerhouse Umamusume enter the Mile 
Championship: North Flight, the strongest 
miler, and Sakura Bakushin O, the 
strongest sprinter.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Biko Pegasus was approached for advice by 
North Flight, who shared that Sakura 
Bakushin O was planning to retire after 
her next race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Because she won too much, Sakura Bakushin 
O said she could no longer have fiery 
showdowns. There was simply no one left 
who dared challenge her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Sakura Bakushin O acted cheerful without 
showing a hint of it. Truly like a real 
hero. Biko Pegasus thinks about wanting to 
lend her a hand.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Right before the race, Biko Pegasus 
declares to Sakura Bakushin O that she 
will be the one to light the fire within 
her heart.
